description:
You focus astral light through a crystalized wisp, reigniting its dormant essence and restoring it to form. The ritual binds the construct to you for an extended time, granting a reliable astral companion shaped from crystallized frost and pure illumination.

Requires a crystalized astral wisp and a light source. Summons one astral wisp for a long duration, without accepting augments.
name: Astral Recrystallization
